explanation: 287-end 25.7 s against 287-start 20.9 s (+23%); the control is origin/main 80af74aef without 287, 24.0 s on the same host alternated with HEAD (per seed main 4.9/4.2/9.3/5.5 s, HEAD 6.8/6.9/5.3/6.7 s). Main's own growth over 287-start is one stage on one seed: seed 39's web, the straggler footpath search (0.82 s at start, 5.76 s on main). Against main, 287's placement guarantees cost about +9 s gross over the four seeds, in the stages that now do the guaranteeing: homesteads +0.35 to +1.1 s a seed (the access tree judged for every candidate seat - the corridor search is most of it), web +0.75 to +1.14 s on seeds 4, 25, 47 (the lane web settled to the whole lane law, the tree's corridors drawn and pruned, the settle's exit asked), hinterland +0.45 to +0.56 s (the belt settled deep and whole, woodland lots cut to their bounds, the registry asked by every writer), and field +0.3 s, +1.27 s on seed 25 (287's sluice position, homes H31, moves that fan to 13 carves). 287's own exact speedups give back about 7 s of it: the straggler route memo (seed 39 web -4.4 s), the board siting (notice -0.6 to -1.1 s a seed) and the windbreak (-0.3 s). Net: +1.7 s (+7%) over main, and the median seed 5.2 -> 6.8 s. Recovery: three passes indexed every per-candidate scan found, byte-identical (35 s -> 25.7 s), and the wood and sun refusals now come before the corridor search. Levers measured and declined: full-pitch-first seat offers (clusters 12-27% looser, up to 28% taller - a form change); dropping the straggler footpaths (-3.0 s, but every map's lanes move - the GM's call, and it exposed a settle gap now closed).
